case: A reservation is released with no event behind its lapse, so passing the lapse point is a comparison nobody made.
why: The guard was called by `held -> released` AND BY NO OTHER, while `partly_consumed -> released` and `uncertain -> released` carried no guard at all -- so a partly-consumed lane could be released without recording the lapsed unconsumed quantity, which is the quantity R-X24 says makes a never-consumed lane visible. Worse, the adverse case as worded is a reservation that takes NO TRANSITION AT ALL: nothing fired when the point passed, there is no `lapsed` phase, and none of the five fields was required. The repair binds the lapse to a ScheduleOccurrence; this mutation removes the demand that the occurrence exist, and the lapse is a field nobody reads again.
